items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson ruled OUT of Wednesday night game vs Rams after concussion evaluation following sideline hit (also dealt with thigh earlier). Will enter protocol.
items.why: Concussion sustained late second quarter; failed to clear for return.
items.implication: Remove from lineups immediately; monitor protocol for Week 13+ availability.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining GB WRs in remaining snaps and future if protocol lingers.

items.text: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) officially ruled OUT for Thanksgiving night vs Bills, missing third straight game. Rookie Emmett Johnson expected to handle workhorse role again after strong recent starts.
items.why: Lingering groin injury; team cautious with soft-tissue history and strong backup play.
items.implication: Sit Walker; elevate handcuff/backup to RB1/2 range in all formats for TNF.
items.opportunity: Full backfield work for backup (high carries, goal-line); Walker ROS uncertainty until cleared.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury suffered in Sunday night win over Vikings. Coach Shanahan: day-to-day, not high ankle; Mac Jones took first-team reps.
items.why: Ankle injury from Week 11; felt bad enough to sit Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday practice; risk for Sunday vs SEA if limited. Have backup plan.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Mac Jones starts; 49ers pass-catchers (CMC, Kittle) still viable but ceiling dips.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving this week vs CAR. Since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC have averaged more fantasy PPG among RBs; elite matchup.
items.why: Elite recent PPG production + soft Carolina matchup.
items.implication: Strong start; RB1 upside this week.
items.opportunity: High snap/usage share expected to continue in positive game script potential.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries. ETR notes injury resurfaced in recent loss.
items.implication: Questionable/elevated risk for Week 12; check further reports. Handcuff/backup relevance rises.
items.opportunity: Potential expanded role for other JAC RBs if limited or OUT.

items.text: Bills TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) returned to limited practice and is questionable for TNF vs Chiefs after missing Week 11. Multiple limited sessions.
items.why: Thumb/ankle ailments; progressing through limited practices.
items.implication: Game-time lean; if active strong TE play vs KC. Have streamer ready.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share if cleared; monitor practice/ status upgrades.

items.text: ETR DFS Top Plays Thanksgiving: With Walker out, Emmett Johnson again handles workhorse responsibilities for KC vs Bills and projects as strong DFS option. Projections live for slate.
items.why: Confirmed Walker absence locks in high-volume role for backup.
items.implication: Start the KC lead back confidently; high carry/RZ share expected.
items.opportunity: Workhorse snaps, carries, goal-line work vs Bills.

items.text: ETR Week 12 preview and multiple reports confirm Puka Nacua (MCL surgery, grade 3 tear off bone) is out for the season (4-5 months recovery); also serving suspension on IR. Terrance Ferguson also season-ending.
items.why: MCL completely tore off tibia plus posterior oblique; surgery required for stability.
items.implication: Drop or stash only in deep IR leagues; zero ROS fantasy value 2026.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for Davante Adams and remaining LAR WRs/TEs (Parkinson with Higbee also dinged).

items.text: ETR Week 12 everything-to-know: Puka and Terrance Ferguson season-ending; Colts cut Daniel Jones with Anthony Richardson set to start; Tuten injury resurfaces. Projections and Thanksgiving shows live; Thorman snaps/pace available.
items.why: Multiple roster/injury developments heading into holiday slate.
items.implication: Adjust Colts skill players for AR start; monitor Tuten closely; zero Puka.
items.opportunity: AR start could alter IND pass/run balance and TE/WR targets (Warren, Downs, Pierce).

items.text: Rams TE Tyler Higbee ruled OUT (chest injury) during Wednesday night game vs Packers; Davis Allen also already out. Leaves thin TE room (Parkinson primary).
items.implication: Stream LAR TE if needed (Parkinson); Adams/others see more volume in passing game.
items.opportunity: TE targets redistribute; possible slight bump to remaining pass-catchers.

items.text: Berry has Bo Nix on HATE list this week vs PIT. Expects heavy Jonah Coleman run game; insufficient Nix rushing to compensate. Outside top 20 QBs.
items.why: Projected run-heavy script vs Steelers defense; limited dual-threat production recently.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats; stream elsewhere if needed.
items.opportunity: Lower pass volume/attempts expected; rushing upside capped.

items.text: Levitan on Travis Etienne: expects disappointing snaps and routes down the stretch but reasonably high carry count/floor. Favorable playoff schedule vs ARZ/ATL in Weeks 16/17. Cites Graziano reporting.
items.why: Role trending toward more carries less receiving; schedule eases late.
items.implication: Viable RB2/flex with carry floor; not elite receiving upside ROS but startable in favorable weeks.
items.opportunity: Carry volume floor; monitor snap/route share for any further decline or rebound.

items.text: Per ETR/Silva Packers matchup notes and injury reports: Josh Jacobs (finger surgery) sidelined another game vs Rams. Backfield to Brooks/Lloyd/Johnson committee with low individual upside vs stout Rams front.
items.why: Finger surgery recovery; one more game expected missed.
items.implication: Avoid GB RBs in tough matchup; low floor for committee pieces.
items.opportunity: Committee shares; limited fantasy relevance this week.

items.text: Evan Silva Packers-Rams matchup: prefers Blake Corum to Kyren Williams in advantageous spot with latter nursing a toe injury. Rams defense stifling enemy RBs.
items.why: Toe issue noted; Corum preferred in matchup context vs Packers.
items.implication: Monitor Kyren status/usage; potential committee or limited efficiency.
items.opportunity: Possible reduced snaps/carries if toe limits; Corum steals work.
